name: relocated-report-runtime
goal: Preserve installed and source-relative report runtime paths after helper owner relocation

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The owner-folder move adjusted all runReport module-relative URLs, including two addresses that Bun resolves from the bundled dist/index.js at runtime. That makes an installed binary look outside its package. Source-relative URLs need relocation; installed output-relative URLs do not.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Environment tests check config precedence and packaged acceptance depends on a full build. Extend the existing report-environment suite with a tiny native bundled installation and sibling CLI fixture, testing runtime roots without source fallback or provider access.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 75391b92 fails the installed-runtime assertion without a source checkout. Immutable red 476ce762b1e3f2b2efa5fd51f6c5159c2385e4300d3e90ed4d8422f0d66f60d3 records the actual bundled launcher exit failure and unchanged environment suite.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Restore the two compiled-output-relative addresses and keep the adjusted source-relative addresses. Exercise a native bundled launcher in the existing environment suite; require source and packaged path review whenever import.meta.url code moves.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Compiled report CLI and Harness CLI addresses again resolve beside dist/index.js. Source-mode URLs retain their new owner-folder depth. The native installed-layout fixture is in normal report environment coverage, and the existing move checkpoint requires both layouts.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Canonical-path test-only commit da5195b3 fails the installed launcher assertion; separate fix 2564dd29 passes unchanged tests and command. Immutable red 0f002f032c25dae6e7192886a3380c952a9530376a4b70e417cab4149c744c85 pairs with green 67130113e06257bbc37918eaf55aad21d25216938e41c9440b9b42d784d28e14. The earlier macOS path-spelling fixture failure remains recorded, not treated as passing proof.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: An isolated archive of 2564dd29 ran the unchanged canonical-path environment suite. Restoring the previous output-relative URLs failed the installed-entry assertion; restoring the repair passed both cases. The live checkout and managed preview were not used as test fixtures. Logs: /tmp/harness-report-relocation-guard-{red,green}.log.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
